info.title: Protecting Against Noise Damage
info.subtitle: Five ways to keep loud sound from costing you your hearing

rows.title: Know the threshold
rows.desc: Sustained sound above 85 dB starts to harm hearing

rows.title: Limit exposure time
rows.desc: The longer the noise lasts, the more damage it does

rows.title: Wear custom plugs
rows.desc: Molded protection lowers volume without muffling

rows.title: Watch your earbuds
rows.desc: Keep volume near half and take listening breaks

rows.title: Get a baseline test
rows.desc: A hearing exam reveals noise damage early
